task.title: Advance durable workflow runs through revision-bound transitions
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/691 under decision https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/690 by persisting one explicit authored transition against the caller-observed run revision.
acceptance_criteria: Require the exact projected stream revision, authored transition index, and exact optional gate acknowledgement for every advancement.
Persist source, edge, resolved target, and gate provenance in one version-one event while retaining immutable topology.
Return typed stale-revision failures without retry or reinterpretation and preserve atomicity across append races.
Replay progress without a registry and reject terminal, malformed, duplicate-start, or topology-inconsistent history fail closed.

attempts.diagnostic: The focused workflow_run_store suite failed because run revisions, durable advancement, and its typed concurrency and transition errors did not exist.
attempts.patch: Added tests for exact progression, gate acknowledgement, stale callers and append races, terminal rejection, reopen projection, and impossible event history.

attempts.diagnostic: Binding phase-relative edge intent to the caller-observed revision prevented a concurrent writer from silently changing the meaning of the requested authored edge.
attempts.patch: Added projected revisions, durable advance, exact-version appends, strict advancement replay, shared cursor transition resolution, ADR-0010, and behavior documentation.

attempts.summary: Resolved and dispositioned substantive review test-maintainability observations.
attempts.diagnostic: CodeRabbit requested explicit duplicate-start coverage and stream-scoped event-count assertions; both were trivial test-hardening observations rather than defects in the verified advancement contract.
attempts.patch: Scoped the event-count assertion to the exact run stream; documented that extra_start_events_are_rejected_as_invalid_history already covered a valid duplicate start; reran focused and repository verification at final head ed304f605ec4fb19e1e87d2756416fc090021cf2.

outcome.summary: Callers can now advance durable workflow runs by exact authored edge and gate evidence without stale intent being retried or reinterpreted.

lessons: Phase-relative intent must be revision-bound so racing writers cannot alter the meaning of an authored transition index.
Persisting source, edge, target, and gate provenance lets replay validate history against the immutable topology snapshot.
Exact-version appends surface both observed staleness and append races through one typed concurrency contract.
Review findings should be fixed when local and non-duplicative, while already-covered cases should receive an explicit evidence-backed disposition.
Advancement records caller choice but does not choose an edge, evaluate a gate, execute an action, invoke a provider or tool, or schedule work.
